say:1:1623491001:1.text: Reeo grabs an Echo Flower and walks straight onto the stage. Bel is too shocked to react—he just stares, mouth hanging open. He doesn't even try to stop him.
say:1:1623491001:1.source_cn: 雷欧手中紧握着回音花，坚定地走上台。或许是因为太过震惊...

say:2:1623491002:1.text: Hey. I'm Reeo. Some of you remember me. Yeah, I'm the student who got branded as "the troublemaker who disrupted the seminar". And I'm still a reporter who actually cares about what's true.
say:2:1623491002:1.source_cn: 大家好，我是雷欧。想必你们之中有人还记得我——是的，我...

say:3:1623491003:1.text: You've noticed it, right? The school newspaper's been getting more and more dramatic. It used to tell you what happened. Now it feels like it's trying to get you worked up.
say:3:1623491003:1.source_cn: 同学们，你们真的没有感觉到吗？这段时间以来，学校的新闻...

say:4:1623491004:1.text: When you hear stuff like that over and over, it gets to you. You stop asking what's true. You just get pulled along by the hype.
say:4:1623491004:1.source_cn: 那些被刻意夸大的言论包裹着我们的耳朵，捂住了我们的眼睛...

say:5:1623491005:1.text: And today, I just want you to hear what's really behind all this, not the sensational story they printed.
say:5:1623491005:1.source_cn: 而今天，我只想让你们听到久违的真相——那隐藏在所谓“爆...

say:6:1623491006:1.text: So just give me one minute. Stay quiet and listen to a recording I captured with this Echo Flower.
say:6:1623491006:1.source_cn: 请大家安静片刻，听一段我通过回音花采集到的现场录音。

say:7:1623491007:1.text: The students trade silent looks as the room slowly quiets down. Reeo switches on the Echo Flower, and the recorded voices begin to play.
say:7:1623491007:1.source_cn: 学生们面面相觑，但最后还是安静了下来。雷欧激活了回音花...

say:9:1623491008:1.text: "As long as you steer the Lyceum's public opinion in the way we want, we'll bump your pay up to the top tier, just like Bel's."
say:9:1623491008:1.source_cn: “只要按照我们要求的方向去引导莱希拉姆的舆论，你未来的...

say:10:1623491009:1.text: "Those weaklings who can't handle their magic or the pressure—they don't belong in the Lyceum anyway!"
say:10:1623491009:1.source_cn: “那些魔力受损、心理承受能力又差劲的废物，本来就不配留...

say:11:1623491010:1.text: "Money decides what I write, simple as that."
say:11:1623491010:1.source_cn: “报酬的多少，直接决定了我的笔尖朝向哪边。”

say:12:1623491011:1.text: "And since we're being honest, those nasty hit pieces that dragged them through the mud? Yeah. I wrote those too."
say:12:1623491011:1.source_cn: “不怕告诉你们，之前那些丑化他们的爆款文章，也全都出自...

say:13:1623491012:1.text: "Only rookies get all precious about 'the truth'. The smart ones just do whatever gets them paid."
say:13:1623491012:1.source_cn: “只有刚入行的新手，才会天真地死抱着所谓的“真相”不放...

say:14:1623491013:1.text: "Hah. I like you, Bel. You get it. We'll keep you on long-term."
say:14:1623491013:1.source_cn: “哈哈……巴布，我很欣赏你的想法，我们会长期找你合作的。”

say:17:1623491014:1.text: That's what I came to show you. You're students here. You can judge for yourselves what's real and what's been pushed on you.
say:17:1623491014:1.source_cn: 以上，就是我今天想要给大家展示的所有内容。事实如何，作...
